## Overview

Visualises accurate and inaccurate reads per million input reads across different MAPQ thresholds, aligners, and read lengths.

| Data dimensions | Values |
|:--|:--|
| **Aligner** | see data |
| **Read length** | 5 different lengths (bp) |
| **MAPQ threshold** | Multiple thresholds (0-60) |
| **Read type** | Accurate (filled markers), Inaccurate (hollow markers) |

**Axes:**
- **X-axis (MAPQ):** Minimum mapping quality threshold
- **Y-axis (Reads per million):** Count of accurately or inaccurately mapped reads per million input reads

---

## Tool import
```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
```

# Load data
```{python}
#| label: load-data

df = pd.read_csv('./data/yield2.csv')

aligners = sorted(df["aligner"].unique())
lengths  = sorted(df["read_length"].unique())

print(f"Aligners: {aligners}")
print(f"Read lengths: {lengths}")
print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")
df.head()
```

# Plot
```{python}
#| label: plotly

# Define visual separators
_palette = [
    "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7",
    "#F0E442", "#56B4E9", "#E69F00", "#999999",
    "#44AA99", "#882255", "#000000",
]
aligner_color = {a: _palette[i % len(_palette)] for i, a in enumerate(aligners)}
_dashes  = ["solid", "dash", "dot", "dashdot", "longdashdot"]
_symbols = ["circle", "square", "diamond", "triangle-up", "cross"]
length_dash   = {l: _dashes[i % len(_dashes)]   for i, l in enumerate(lengths)}
length_symbol = {l: _symbols[i % len(_symbols)] for i, l in enumerate(lengths)}

# Traces
fig = go.Figure()
trace_meta = []

for aligner in aligners:
    for length in lengths:
        sub = (
            df[(df["aligner"] == aligner) & (df["read_length"] == length)]
            .sort_values("mapq")  # ensures curve runs low→high MAPQ
        )
        if sub.empty:
            continue

        trace_meta.append((aligner, length, "accurate"))
        # Accurate reads trace (filled markers)
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=sub["mapq"],
            y=sub["accurate_per_million"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=f"{aligner} | {length}bp (accurate)",
            line=dict(
                color=aligner_color[aligner],
                dash=length_dash[length],
                width=2
            ),
            marker=dict(
                symbol=length_symbol[length],
                size=8,
                color=aligner_color[aligner]
            ),
            customdata=sub[["mapq"]].values,
            hovertemplate=(
                "<b>%{fullData.name}</b><br>"
                "MAPQ ≥ %{customdata[0]}<br>"
                "Accurate reads/million: %{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>"
            ),
        ))
        
        trace_meta.append((aligner, length, "inaccurate"))
        # Inaccurate reads trace (hollow markers)
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=sub["mapq"],
            y=sub["inaccurate_per_million"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=f"{aligner} | {length}bp (inaccurate)",
            line=dict(
                color=aligner_color[aligner],
                dash=length_dash[length],
                width=2
            ),
            marker=dict(
                symbol=length_symbol[length],
                size=8,
                color="rgba(255,255,255,0)",  # transparent fill
                line=dict(color=aligner_color[aligner], width=2)
            ),
            customdata=sub[["mapq"]].values,
            hovertemplate=(
                "<b>%{fullData.name}</b><br>"
                "MAPQ ≥ %{customdata[0]}<br>"
                "Inaccurate reads/million: %{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>"
            ),
        ))

n = len(trace_meta)

# --- Utility button helper ---
# "legendonly" = hidden but still listed in legend (re-clickable)
def make_visible(pred):
    return [True if pred(a, l, t) else "legendonly" for a, l, t in trace_meta]

show_hide = [
    dict(label="Show all", method="restyle", args=[{"visible": [True] * n}]),
    dict(label="Hide all", method="restyle", args=[{"visible": ["legendonly"] * n}]),
]
only_accurate = [
    dict(label="Only accurate", method="restyle",
         args=[{"visible": make_visible(lambda a, l, t, t_type="accurate": t == t_type)}]),
]
only_inaccurate = [
    dict(label="Only inaccurate", method="restyle",
         args=[{"visible": make_visible(lambda a, l, t, t_type="inaccurate": t == t_type)}]),
]
by_aligner = [
    dict(label=f"Only {a}", method="restyle",
         args=[{"visible": make_visible(lambda al, _l, _t, a=a: al == a)}])
    for a in aligners
]
by_length = [
    dict(label=f"Only {l}bp", method="restyle",
         args=[{"visible": make_visible(lambda _a, ln, _t, l=l: ln == l)}])
    for l in lengths
]

# --- Layout ---
fig.update_layout(
    title="Yield — Accurate Reads vs. MAPQ Threshold",
    xaxis=dict(title="MAPQ Threshold", gridwidth=1, range=[0, 60]),
    yaxis=dict(title="Reads per Million Input", range=[0, 1000000]),
    hovermode="closest",
    legend=dict(
        title="<b>Aligner | Length</b><br><sup>click = toggle, dbl = isolate</sup>",
        itemclick="toggle",
        itemdoubleclick="toggleothers",
    ),
    updatemenus=[
        dict(type="buttons", buttons=show_hide,
             direction="right", showactive=False,
             x=0.0, y=1.30, xanchor="left", yanchor="top",
             bgcolor="#EEEEEE", bordercolor="#AAAAAA"),
        dict(type="buttons", buttons=only_accurate + only_inaccurate,
             direction="right", showactive=True,
             x=0.0, y=1.21, xanchor="left", yanchor="top",
             bgcolor="#FFDDDD", bordercolor="#AAAAAA"),
        dict(type="buttons", buttons=by_aligner,
             direction="right", showactive=True,
             x=0.0, y=1.12, xanchor="left", yanchor="top",
             bgcolor="#DDEEFF", bordercolor="#AAAAAA"),
        dict(type="buttons", buttons=by_length,
             direction="right", showactive=True,
             x=0.0, y=1.03, xanchor="left", yanchor="top",
             bgcolor="#DDFFF0", bordercolor="#AAAAAA"),
    ],
    margin=dict(t=160, r=20, b=60, l=80),
    width=1000, height=650,
)

fig.show()
```
